households.description: Renter with Chase checking and card, an Amex, Ally savings and a second checking at Bank of America. Equal scheduled savings transfers that cross, rent split with a roommate, Zelle both ways, card refunds next to equal bills, weakly worded and long-weekend transfers.

Family with Bank of America checking and savings, a Capital One and a Citi card, and a credit union checking. Two balance transfers on days both cards are paid the same amount, bills equal to savings moves, deposits equal to brokerage outflows, transfers with no wording.

Retiree with Wells Fargo checking and savings, Ally savings, an Amex and a Discover card. Pension days with an equal savings withdrawal, card charges equal to deposits, crossing equal transfers to Ally, one-sided wording and long-weekend landings.
